newsitem.title: USA: Paper Brent crude advances in late U.S. trading.
newsitem.headline: Paper Brent crude advances in late U.S. trading.

text.p: Paper Brent crude oil advanced in late U.S. paper trading on Thursday, with three full boats changing hands, traders said.
A full boat of July Brent traded at $18.38 a barrel, up six cents from the IPE settlement in London.
Two full boats of August Brent switched hands at $18.60 and $18.65 a barrel, while a partial cargo traded at $18.60.
August Brent settled at $18.47 a barrel.
June/July Brent was assessed around minus 35 cents, two cents weaker than an earlier deal.
July/August Brent traded at minus 24 cents and minus 25 cents, also a shade weaker than earlier transactions.
Finally, August/September was talked at minus 19/16 cents a barrel, within range of the day's earlier level.
